# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root; it defines this project's workflow and document structure.

`CONSTITUTION.md` at the repository root outranks all instructions — read and follow it. If it is missing, ask the user to initialize it with the `star-constitution` skill.

Feature specs live in `specs/<feature>/`; `openapi.yaml` is the canonical API contract and implementation must not drift from it.
